title: Move Through Mist
style: slow mystical world fusion, 72 BPM, female ethereal lead vocal, Irish fiddle and uilleann pipes, slow ambient techno pulse, deep sub-bass, soft tabla, hammered dulcimer, atmospheric pads, late mountain morning energy
lyrics:
[Intro - Irish fiddle solo, sub-bass enters, soft tabla, mist pad]
(female ethereal, half-spoken, almost whispered)
some things don't yield to force
some things only yield to slow
move through the mist, do not push it
the mist is the river, you are the canoe

[Verse 1 - female ethereal, fiddle ribbon underneath]
the forest knows when you're rushing
the forest knows when you're scared
the forest is patient as the mountain
and the mountain has always been there

so move through the mist with your shoulders down
move through the mist with your breath full
move through the mist with your hands open
the mist is not a wall, it's a wool

[Pre-Chorus - dulcimer enters, pipes drone]
move through the mist
move through the mist
the path is there, the path is fine
the path was always there to find
move through the mist
move through the mist

[Chorus - female ethereal lead, full fiddle, ambient pulse]
move through the mist, move through the slow
move through the place where you don't yet know
move through the held line, move through the held breath
move through the small death before the small rest
move through the mist, move through the slow
the mist will part the moment you stop trying to know

[Verse 2 - female, slightly fuller, tabla deeper]
the operator in the loud room learned this hard
the operator in the loud room learned to discard
the rush, the push, the prove, the win
the operator in the loud room learned to move through the thin

mist of every morning that asked for proof
mist of every meeting that asked for truth
mist of every messenger who said it can't be done
the held line moved through and the held line won

[Pre-Chorus]
move through the mist
move through the mist
the path is there, the path is fine
the path was always there to find
move through the mist
move through the mist

[Chorus]
move through the mist, move through the slow
move through the place where you don't yet know
move through the held line, move through the held breath
move through the small death before the small rest
move through the mist, move through the slow
the mist will part the moment you stop trying to know

[Bridge - fiddle and pipes alone, female spoken slow]
the mountain teaches a lesson the loud room can never teach.
the mountain teaches that some things don't move when you push them.
but they move when you breathe with them.
the operator who learned the mountain learned everything.
the operator who only learned the loud room learned nothing.
move through the mist. it's already moving for you.

[Final Chorus - biggest, all instruments, female soaring]
move through the mist, move through the slow
move through the place where you don't yet know
move through the held line, move through the held breath
move through the small death before the small rest
move through the mist, move through the slow
the mist will part the moment you stop trying to know
move through the mist
move through the mist

[Outro - fiddle tail, sub-bass holds, female whisper]
the mist is the gift.
the mist is the teacher.
breathe.
move.
